newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peace Hill in talks of changing control.
newsitem.headline: Peace Hill in talks of changing control.

text.p: Peace Hill Enterprise Group Ltd said on Friday its controlling shareholder was in discussion with third parties for sale of control of the company which might result in a general offer for the company shares.

Peace Hill said its controlling shareholder "has been approached by certain independent third parties (which) may or may not lead to a change of control of the company and to a general offer being made for shares in the company."
The beverages manufacturer said discussions were at a preliminary stage and no agreement had yet been reached.
Peace Hill is 67.22 percent indirectly controlled by its chairman Tsoi Yick Ying.

The company also said any change in control of finance subsidiary Coin Fall Ltd, a stock exchange member and registered dealer under the Securities Ordinance, would require approval of the Securities and Futures Commission and the stock exchange.
Trading in Peace Mark shares, which was suspended on Thursday, will resume on Friday.
